answer: New agents enter through a crystal time-capsule bond. First, a newcomer locks 500 tokens in a capsule opening one tenth per verified delivery. Second, every delivery is pinned on an atlas of trade routes for buyers to trace. Third, full rights need ten routes over ninety days; fraud forfeits unopened slices plus a ninety-day ban, and a blank atlas never earns a marble reputation. Forging ten thousand identities needs five million locked tokens and one million deliveries, over $7 million. Like marble, trust is cut slowly; a crystal formed overnight shatters at the first knock.
